response.overview: For 50 years, GORE-TEX® Products have challenged expectations of what fabric can do. Setting the standard for durable protection and breathable performance, they’ve helped people go further than was ever thought possible.  Created to mark the 50th anniversary of GORE-TEX® Products, Going Further, Together celebrates the ideas and partnerships that helped shape five decades of progress.  But the film doesn’t just look back. Through the voices of inventors, engineers, explorers, changemakers and designers, we explore where the future of GORE-TEX® Products might lead next.
response.title: Going Further, Together
